method_summary: Implements a BADGE-inspired active learning strategy that constructs gradient embeddings by weighting each pair's feature vector by sigmoid(logit)*(1-sigmoid(logit)) — the expected gradient magnitude of cross-entropy loss, which peaks at the decision boundary. From the top-10k highest-norm gradient embedding candidates, k pairs are selected via k-means++ greedy maximization of minimum cosine distance, combining uncertainty sampling with gradient-space diversity to cover the most informative ambiguous regions.
